title: THE HEIR APPARENT // SHAGGYDOG'S GROWL
narrative: Davos strides into the Merman's Court in White Harbor holding the boy Rickon by the hand. Shaggydog steps forward, twice the size of any pony, baring fangs black with dried blood. Wyman Manderly weeps openly into his multiple chins: 'The son of the Ned lives! The mummer's farce is finished! Rouse the levies!'
resolvesPlotHole: Rickon Stark Returns to the North

options.text: March the White Harbor armored host to relieve Winterfell.
Proclaim the young wolf King in the North.
